title: Disability Compensation Rate Table: Veteran-Alone Monthly Rates
content:
**Disability Compensation — monthly rate schedule, rates effective December 1, 2025**

Disability Compensation is paid at the rate of the combined service-connected rating the award carries. The award carries exactly one tier, and each tier is identified by its combined rating, from Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) through Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating) in ten-point steps. The veteran-alone rate is the monthly amount for a veteran with no recognized dependents at that rating, in US dollars. The last column states whether additional amounts for dependents are payable at that rating.

| Tier | Combined rating (percent) | Veteran-alone monthly rate (USD) | Additional amounts for dependents payable |
|---|---|---|---|
| Disability Compensation (10% Combined Rating) | 10 | 180.42 | No |
| Disability Compensation (20% Combined Rating) | 20 | 356.66 | No |
| Disability Compensation (30% Combined Rating) | 30 | 552.47 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating) | 40 | 795.84 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating) | 50 | 1132.90 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (60% Combined Rating) | 60 | 1435.02 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (70% Combined Rating) | 70 | 1808.45 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (80% Combined Rating) | 80 | 2102.15 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (90% Combined Rating) | 90 | 2362.30 | Yes |
| Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating) | 100 | 3938.58 | Yes |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. Dependent amounts are payable only at 30 percent or higher. At the 10 percent and 20 percent tiers no amount is added for a spouse, child, school child or dependent parent, whatever the award records.
2. The rates are monthly amounts in dollars and cents; they are not rounded to the dollar.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustrations)**

- An award carrying Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating) has a veteran-alone rate of 1132.90 a month, and dependent amounts are payable at that tier.
- An award carrying Disability Compensation (20% Combined Rating) has a veteran-alone rate of 356.66 a month; because dependent amounts are not payable at that tier, a recognized spouse adds nothing to it.
- The step from Disability Compensation (90% Combined Rating) to Disability Compensation (100% Combined Rating) moves the veteran-alone rate from 2362.30 to 3938.58.
